question: Who became the new CEO of Hazeltree in August 2026?

hits.title: Weekly news - week of august 3, 2026.
hits.snippet: Hazeltree has named founder Remy Trafelet Chairman, President and Chief Executive, succeeding Lokesh Seth.

hits.title: Walrus security and Hazeltree announce strategic partnership.
hits.snippet: Walrus Security, Inc. is excited to announce its strategic partnership with Hazeltree to bring stronger, more streamlined payment security to alternative investment firms.

hits.title: Hazeltree welcomes Eassey.
hits.snippet: Hazeltree has welcomed Derek Eassey to the team as senior director of human resources.

hits.title: Hazeltree acquires Siman Systems
hits.snippet: Hazeltree has acquired Siman Systems, a provider of margin replication and financing analytics technology.

hits.title: Hazeltree acquires Siman Systems, expanding its Treasury Management platform to include enhanced Margin Replication.
hits.snippet: Hazeltree welcomes David Simpson, the new Managing Director of Hedge Funds, Ray McGrath, Director of Platform and Engineering, and also extends a warm welcome to Siman's team of hedge fund treasury solutions experts.

hits.title: TreasurySpring and Hazeltree announce strategic partnership to integrate fixed-term investment products into Hazeltree's platform.
hits.snippet: [30 July, London / New York] TreasurySpring, the global cash investment platform, has today announced a strategic partnership with Hazeltree, the leading provider of integrated treasury and liquidity management and optimisation solutions for the alternative asset management market.

hits.title: Hazeltree Appoints Lokesh Seth as Chief Executive Officer
hits.snippet: Hazeltree appoints Lokesh Seth as Chief Executive Officer.

hits.title: Dimmick joins Hazeltree
hits.snippet: Hazeltree, a treasury and liquidity management technology firm, has appointed Chris Dimmick as head of collateral product.

hits.title: Hazeltree selects Necto API for zConnect platform
hits.snippet: Hazeltree, a New York-based and cloud-based treasury and liquidity management platform, has partnered with Necto API to enhance its global bank connectivity network, helping clients to access a broader range of financial data sources.

accuracy.note: Same name; middle initial omitted but equivalent

ar.note: Rank 1 names Remy Trafelet as new Chairman/President/CEO of Hazeltree in Aug 2026; others don't.
